tasks.subject: Task 1: store prev-windows, 24h series, oldest sample
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `QueryMetricsPrevWindows`, `QueryMetricsSeries` and `OldestMetricsSample` in the store package, fully tested.

**Files:**
- Modify: `backend/internal/store/metrics.go` (append three functions + exported `SeriesBuckets` const)
- Modify: `backend/internal/store/metrics_test.go` (append three tests)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Prev-window sums: seeds just inside/outside each baseline band produce {6h: 6, 12h: 24, 24h: 96, 7d: 768}; empty table → all four keys present, zero; no "30d" key
- [ ] Series: length exactly 288; offsets 2min/7min/23h58m land in slots 287/286/0; row older than 24h excluded; same-bucket rows sum; empty table → 288 zeros
- [ ] Oldest sample: empty table → zero time, nil error; seeded table → earliest ts round-trips
- [ ] `go test ./internal/store/ -count=1` passes

**Verify:** `cd backend && go test ./internal/store/ -run 'TestQueryMetricsPrevWindows|TestQueryMetricsSeries|TestOldestMetricsSample' -count=1 -v` → all PASS

**Steps:** TDD per plan Task 1 (full code in the plan): three failing tests first; then `SeriesBuckets = 288`, `QueryMetricsPrevWindows` (single statement, four `SUM(CASE WHEN ts > ? AND ts <= ? …)` columns, scan bounded by 14d cutoff, all cutoffs RFC3339Nano strings), `QueryMetricsSeries` (rows within 24h bucketed in Go, `idx = 287 - int(now.Sub(ts)/5min)`), `OldestMetricsSample` (`SELECT MIN(ts)`, NULL → zero time). Commit `git commit -s -m "feat(store): prev-window baselines, 24h series and oldest metrics sample"` (never Co-Authored-By).

tasks.subject: Task 2: /api/metrics windows_prev, series, oldest_sample
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The `obs` section of `/api/metrics` carries the three new fields with the established warn-and-zero error convention.

**Files:**
- Modify: `backend/internal/api/metrics.go` (obsSection fields + handler population + doc comment)
- Modify: `backend/internal/api/metrics_test.go` (extra seeds + assertions)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Seeded db (7@1h, 9@3d, 5@8h, 20@8d) yields `windows` {6h:7, 12h:12, 24h:12, 7d:21, 30d:41}, `windows_prev` {6h:5, 12h:0, 24h:0, 7d:20}, `series` length 288 with series[275]==7 and series[191]==5, non-empty RFC3339 `oldest_sample`
- [ ] All three new keys present in the raw JSON under `obs`
- [ ] Handler signature unchanged; store errors → `slog.Warn` + zero values, HTTP 200
- [ ] `go test ./... -count=1 && go build ./...` pass

**Verify:** `cd backend && go test ./internal/api/ -run TestMetricsHandler -count=1 -v` → PASS

**Steps:** TDD per plan Task 2 (full code in the plan): extend TestMetricsHandler first (two extra seeds, new wantWindows, wantPrev/series/oldest assertions, raw-key loop); then obsSection gains `WindowsPrev`/`Series`/`OldestSample` fields, handler queries all four store functions with one shared `now := time.Now().UTC()`, per-query warn+zero fallbacks, `oldest_sample` formatted RFC3339 ("" for zero time), doc comment extended. Commit `git commit -s -m "feat(api): prev-window baselines, 24h series and oldest sample in /api/metrics"` (never Co-Authored-By).

tasks.subject: Task 3: panel sparkline card + variation tile strip
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The metrics panel renders mockup C: slim OBS card with a 24h sparkline; a full-width strip of five window tiles with ▲/▼ percentage or muted "—".

**Files:**
- Modify: `frontend/src/types/metrics.ts` (three fields)
- Modify: `frontend/src/components/MetricsPanel.vue` (script + template)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `MetricsSnapshot.obs` has `windows_prev: Record<string, number>`, `series: number[]`, `oldest_sample: string`
- [ ] OBS card: total + req/s + SVG sparkline (polyline, `var(--brand-purple)` stroke) + caption "requests per 5 min · last 24h"; old in-card window list removed
- [ ] Tile strip between the 3-column grid and the endpoint table: five tiles (label, count, delta); ▲ `var(--ok)` positive, ▼ `var(--fail)` negative, neutral "0%", muted "—" for 30d / zero baseline / warm-up (oldest_sample empty or newer than now − 2×window)
- [ ] `npm run build` exits 0

**Verify:** `cd frontend && npm run build` → exit 0

**Steps:** Per plan Task 3 (full code in the plan): type fields; script — WINDOW_MS map, `windowDelta(k): number | null`, `tiles` computed, `sparkPoints` computed (180×34 viewBox, max-normalized); template — replace in-card window list with sparkline block, insert tile strip between grid and endpoint table. Commit `git commit -s -m "feat(overview): sparkline card and variation tile strip in metrics panel"` (never Co-Authored-By).
